text:
This is for all the people that are unaware about KAI & his music being nominated for multiple awards & additional details:
Please vote for KAI's "Mmmh" on M Wave's website: https://www.mwave.me/en/vote/mcountdown/vote . Voting ends on December 14th.
It's for M COUNTDOWN PRE VOTING. It seems like another music show.  You could sign-in with a social account: KAKAO, Twitter, NAVER, LINE, Facebook, Tumblr, Google, weibo.com, & We Chat. 1 vote per account, though. You could use as many accounts you want to vote for KAI. 

If you are a fan of EXO and/or KAI, please help support this brother by voting for him wherever he's nominated. 
You could also download the apps, CHOEAEDOL, IDOL CHAMP, FanPlus, MuBeat, Whosfan, V Live, etc. from the Google Play Store & Apple Store. 
Here's at least 3 websites from KAI's trusted fanbases: stationkai.com , erigomnation.com & kaivoting.page . 
KAI's solo fandom's name is Erigom (L bear), but he often refers to his fans as EXO-L or Eris & other variations of the name. 
EXO's fandom name is EXO-L (EXO-Love). 
Of course, if you can, please continue to stream all of KAI's solo music videos & other solo related videos, including his solo performance videos, because views are included in the voting criteria. 
You don't have to do anything you don't want to do, but it would greatly appreciated if you could join us in helping to support the new solo artist, KAI aka Kim Jong-in. It would be a wonderful early birthday gift. His birthday is on January 14th.  

Kim Jong-in aka KAI deserves for us to at least try to vote & help him win some awards for working very hard to give us his solo project & all this extra content that we didn't know we wanted, but we are glad we received it. It's just a way to show your gratitude. 
I'm sure he'll appreciate us making an effort, although he is very humble & didn't ask us for anything in return. 
However, like any other artist, he just wants people check out & appreciate him, his art & his other work. 
As you can see, this brother is very passionate about his craft. I haven't noticed him do anything halfway. Also, he's a perfectionist, who is sometimes too hard on himself, although everyone else thought he did an amazing job. 
He's even not afraid to express his emotions in a society with some people who often give some males a hard time for being in tuned with their emotions & sensitive side. He's not afraid to breakdown gender barriers either. He's a very artistic, quirky, intelligent, hilarious, kind-hearted & down to earth, respectable, personable, & multitalented guy. 
This is the same guy that was surprised that he had more international fans than he thought did & that a lot people enjoyed his dancing, his work, & him in general. 
Just watch some of his latest videos & feel him out for yourself. You'll see the type of person he is for yourself. He's a stand up guy. 
KAI is just a stage name & a charismatic idol persona, Kim Jong-in is the complex man behind the "KAI" image, & Nini is the very soft & shy side of Kim Jong-in. His duality is something special. 

Also, he's doing a lot of self-promoting activities almost like an independent artist & some things he wanted to do for himself, his family & loved ones, & his fans. This solo project is KAI aka Kim Jong-in's baby. SM finally gave him more creative freedom to what he wanted to do. 
Therefore, it's KAI's vision, not SM's doing. What you see & get is coming from KAI & his team. Don't give SM too much credit when they don't deserve it. Moreover, KAI invested his blood, sweat & tears into his solo project, especial his own money.

Anyway, if you are interested & use Twitter, Facebook & Instagram, please search for more info. Even Google, if it's necessary. 
It's OK to watch his introduction guides to learn more about KAI aka Kim Jong-in, but please make sure you pick good up to date ones. 
Follow KAI's Instagram account: zkdlin @ instagram.com/zkdlin . 
Again, here's at least 3 websites from KAI's trusted fanbases: stationkai.com , erigomnation.com & kaivoting.page .  
A lot information is available on these websites. They have more, but I don't know them all, sorry. These are the main ones I know. 
Reminder: KAI's solo fandom's name is Erigom (L bear), but he often refers to his fans as EXO-L or Eris & other variations of the name. 
EXO's fandom name is EXO-L (EXO-Love). 
Here's a website that offers some basic info about Kim Jong-in aka KAI & is often used by some new fans: https://kprofiles.com/kai-profile-facts-kai-ideal-type/ . 
Last but not least, please feel free to ask his most knowledgeable fans, some Erigoms & EXO-Ls since they are the ones who support KAI the most. Keyword: Some, not all.

author: @exosellie
text:
EXO is a nine-member boy band.
The stage name EXO is derived from the word 'EXOPLANET', which plays right into their group concept.

EXO is known for their outstanding vocal capabilities and are considered 'The Vocal Kings'. They also have the best dance line also known as the "Dancing Kings" in general.

*EXO Members' Profile:*

*Xiumin*  [Power: Frost]
• Birth Name: Kim MinSeok
• Birthdate: March 26th, 1990
• Position debut: Lead vocal
• Position now: Lead vocal, lead dancer, rapper
• Also part of: EXO-M, EXO-CBX
• Funfact: Is called fairy by fans for his kind personally and ageless visuals.

*Suho*  [Power: Water]
• Birth Name: Kim JunMyeon
• Birthdate: May 22nd, 1991
• Position debut: Leader, lead vocal
• Position now: Leader, main vocal
• Also part of: EXO-K, Solo
• Funfact: Wants to be the future director of SM, is an outstanding musical actor.

*Lay*  [Power: Healing]
• Birth Name: Zhang Yixing
• Birthdate: October 7th, 1991
• Position debut: Main dancer, vocal
• Position now: Main dancer, lead vocal. Currently absent from EXO, due to complicated political relations between Korea and China
• Also part of: EXO-M, Solo
• Funfact: EXO's only Chinese. member. Self produces, and directs most of his music and videos.

*BaekHyun*  [Power: Light]
• Birth Name: Byun BaekHyun
• Birthdate: May 6th, 1992
• Position debut: Main vocal
• Position now: Main vocal
• Also part of: EXO-K, EXO-CBX, Solo, SuperM
• Funfact: Is a genius idol and can do everything he wants to.

*Chen*  [Power: Lightning]
• Birth Name: Kim JongDae
• Birthdate: September 21st, 1992
• Position debut: Main vocal
• Position now: Main vocal
• Also part of: EXO-M, EXO-CBX, Solo
• Funfact: Is considered the best vocalist generally and is very kind hearted.

*Chanyeol*  [Power: Fire]
• Birth Name: Park ChanYeol
• Birthdate: November 27th, 1992
• Position debut: Main rapper, vocal
• Position now: Main rapper, vocal
• Also part of: EXO-K, EXO-SC
• Funfact: Produces his own music and has his own studio NNG. Plays several instruments.

*D.O.*  [Power: Earth]
• Birth Name: Doh KyungSoo
• Birthdate: January 12th, 1993
• Position debut: Main vocal
• Position now: Main vocal
• Also part of: EXO-K
• Funfact: Is considered the best idol actor. Is a licensed cook. RnB King

*Kai*  [Power: Teleportation]
• Birth Name: Kim JongIn
• Birthdate: January 14th, 1994
• Position debut: Main dancer, lead rapper, vocals, center
• Position now: Main dancer, lead vical, lead rapper, center
• Also part of: EXO-K, SuperM, Solo
• Funfact: Is known as the Idol of idols and Asia's first love. Is arguably the best danger in general. Also called the vocal colour King.

*Sehun*  [Power: Wind]
• Birth Name: Oh SeHun
• Birthdate: April 12th, 1994
• Position debut: Lead rapper, vocal
• Position now: Main rapper, lead dancer, vocal
• Also part of: EXO-K, EXO-SC
• Funfact: Is mischievous and very loyal towards his members. Loves and participates in Action movies. Is known for his handsome looks.


Since the members are trained in every aspect, they can therefore easily overtake other positions.
Furthermore, EXO is a vocal heavy group in which each member has a distinct voice, but they are also totally tuned and attuned to one another. That's why it's amazingly dovetail when one member stops singing and the other picks it up.


EXO is arguably one of the most concept heavy groups. They don’t just have MV ‘concepts’ they have their own group ‘mythos’.
According to the mythos, the EXO members are aliens from EXOPLANET. Each member has his own super power. They are chased by an evil force named 'The Red-Force'.
While running from the Red-Force EXO landed on earth. According to theories, the EXO members have lost their memories and live as normal humans on earth, until the mysterious things begin to happen.

EXO's music release dates always overlap with astronomic events.
Until now, every EXO album release date has overlapped with the exact date solar eclipses were seen on Earth!

EXO's motto is 'We Are One'.
EXO and EXO-L also often used the words 'EXO Saranghaja'.
Saranghaja means - Let's Love.
Bepfore EXO goes on stage, all EXO members will hold hands with each other and scream "EXO SARANGAHJA!"

The group originally had twelve members and was divided into two units, EXO-K and EXO-M. The former consisted of Korean members while the latter had Chinese members. Eventually, three members of EXO-M went separate career paths, leading to the nine-member group formation.

EXO fans are called EXO-L.

The L stands for Love.
It is also the 12th letter in the alphabet and is between K and M (EXO-K, EXO-L, EXO-M). This makes the fandom part of EXO, instead of just a fandom.

A nickname used between the members for their fans is Aeris/Eri. It's derived from EXO-L.

text: 하나님은 당신에게 다음과 같은 메시지를 보내 십니다 : 당신의 공허함을 채울 수있는 능력을 가진 유일한 소망은 저입니다. 슬픔과 우울증에서 자유롭고, 치유 할 수 있고 진정으로 저를 축복 할 수 있지만 가장 중요한 것은 당신입니다.  구원을주고 영생은 예수님을 통해 나입니다.  인생은 짧고 영원은 아닙니다. 천국이나 지옥 불의 두 가지 방법이 있습니다. 세상은이 메시지를 듣고 싶어하지 않습니다. 그러나 그것은 여러분이 상상할 수있는 것보다 더 현실적입니다. 영원 속에서 영혼을 잃지 마십시오.  이기도를 전심으로 반복하고 믿으십시오.  주 예수님, 저는 죄를 인식하고, 회개하며, 당신을 유일하고 배타적 인 구세주로 받아들이고, 다른 누구에게는 구원이 없으며, 당신이 아버지에게 유일한 길이라는 것을, 생명책에 내 이름을 쓰십시오.  당신.  이제 당신은 구원 받았고 매일기도하고 성경을 읽고 실패하면 회개하고 그는 당신을 용서할 것입니다.  성령 님 께서 당신의 뜻을 행하고 죄를 짓지 않고 주님을 기쁘시게하지 않는 것을 막으라고 지시하라고 말씀하십시오.  그리스도는 곧 오 십니다.  이 단어를 확인하는 다음 구절을 남깁니다.  요한 복음 14 장 예수님, 아버지 께가는 길 1 마음에 근심하지 마십시오.  당신은 신을 믿고 나도 믿습니다.  2 내 아버지의 집에는 많은 저택이 있습니다.  그렇지 않다면 나는 당신에게 말했을 것입니다.  그래서 나는 당신을위한 장소를 준비 할 것입니다.  3 내가 가서 너를 위해 자리를 마련하면 내가 다시 와서 너를 데려 가서 내가 여기있을 수 있도록 너도있을 것이다.  4 당신은 내가 어디로 가는지, 당신은 길을 알고 있습니다.  5 토마스가 그에게 말했다 : 주님, 우리는 당신이 어디로 가는지 모릅니다.  그러면 우리는 방법을 어떻게 알 수 있습니까?  6 예수 께서 그에게 이르시되 나는 길이 요 진리 요 생명이다.  나를 위해서만 아버지에게 오지 않습니다.  7 네가 나를 안다면 내 아버지도 알고있을 것이다.  이제부터 우리는 그를 알았고 당신은 그를 보았습니다.  요한 계시록 20:15 15 생명책에 기록되지 않은 사람은 불못에 던져졌습니다.

text:
Konferensi medis tahunan Denmark, Doctor Week, diadakan di Copenhagen tanggal 11-15 November 2019. Para profesional medis yang menghadiri konferensi terus memperhatikan pengambilan organ yang disetujui negara oleh Partai Komunis Tiongkok (PKT) yang diambil dari praktisi Falun Gong yang masih hidup.






Perwakilan DAFOH (Doctors Against Forced Organ Harvesting) mendiskusikan pengambilan organ secara paksa di Tiongkok selama Doctor Week, pertemuan tahunan para profesional medis yang diadakan di Kopenhagen

Acara selama lima hari ini dihadiri oleh sekitar 3.500 profesional medis dari Denmark, Greenland, dan Kepulauan Faroe. Sejumlah kecil dokter dan perawat Nordik juga menghadiri pertemuan itu.

Organisasi non-pemerintah internasional DAFOH (Doctors Against Forced Organ Harvesting), menjadi tuan rumah sebuah stan dan memberi tahu para peserta tentang pengambilan organ secara hidup-hidup oleh rezim Tiongkok dari para tahanan hati nurani, termasuk para praktisi Falun Gong, orang-orang dari Xinjiang dan Tibet, dan orang-orang Kristen.

author: @exosellie
text:
EXO is a nine-member boy band.
The stage name EXO is derived from the word 'Exoplanet', which plays right into their group concept.

The group originally had twelve members and was divided into two units, EXO-K and EXO-M. The former consisted of Korean members while the latter had Chinese members. Eventually, three members of EXO-M went separate career paths, leading to the nine-member group formation.

EXO is known for their outstanding vocal capabilities and are considered 'The Vocal Kings'. They also have the best dance line also known as the "Dancing Kings" in general.


*EXO Members' Profile:*

*Xiumin*  [Power: Frost]
• Birth Name: Kim MinSeok
• Birthdate: March 26th, 1990
• Position debut: Lead vocal
• Position now: Lead vocal, lead dancer, rapper
• Also part of: EXO-M, EXO-CBX
• Funfact: Is called fairy by fans for his kind personally and ageless visuals.

*Suho*  [Power: Water]
• Birth Name: Kim JunMyeon
• Birthdate: May 22nd, 1991
• Position debut: Leader, lead vocal
• Position now: Leader, main vocal
• Also part of: EXO-K, Solo
• Funfact: Wants to be the future director of SM, is an outstanding musical actor.

*Lay*  [Power: Healing]
• Birth Name: Zhang Yixing
• Birthdate: October 7th, 1991
• Position debut: Main dancer, vocal
• Position now: Main dancer, lead vocal
• Also part of: EXO-M, Solo
• Funfact: Self produces, and directs most of his music and videos.

*BaekHyun*  [Power: Light]
• Birth Name: Byun BaekHyun
• Birthdate: May 6th, 1992
• Position debut: Main vocal
• Position now: Main vocal
• Also part of: EXO-K, EXO-CBX, Solo, SuperM
• Funfact: Is a genius idol and can do everything he wants to.

*Chen*  [Power: Lightning]
• Birth Name: Kim JongDae
• Birthdate: September 21st, 1992
• Position debut: Main vocal
• Position now: Main vocal
• Also part of: EXO-M, EXO-CBX, Solo
• Funfact: Is considered the best vocalist generally and is very kind hearted.

*Chanyeol*  [Power: Fire]
• Birth Name: Park ChanYeol
• Birthdate: November 27th, 1992
• Position debut: Main rapper, vocal
• Position now: Main rapper, vocal
• Also part of: EXO-K, EXO-SC
• Funfact: Produces his own music and has his own studio NNG. Plays several instruments.

*D.O.*  [Power: Earth]
• Birth Name: Doh KyungSoo
• Birthdate: January 12th, 1993
• Position debut: Main vocal
• Position now: Main vocal
• Also part of: EXO-K
• Funfact: Is considered the best idol actor. Is a licensed cook. RnB King

*Kai*  [Power: Teleportation]
• Birth Name: Kim JongIn
• Birthdate: January 14th, 1994
• Position debut: Main dancer, lead rapper, vocals, center
• Position now: Main dancer, lead vical, lead rapper, center
• Also part of: EXO-K, SuperM, Solo
• Funfact: Is known as the Idol of idols and Asia's first love. Is arguably the best danger in general. Also called the vocal colour King.

*Sehun*  [Power: Wind]
• Birth Name: Oh SeHun
• Birthdate: April 12th, 1994
• Position debut: Lead rapper, vocal
• Position now: Main rapper, lead dancer, vocal
• Also part of: EXO-K, EXO-SC
• Funfact: Is mischievous and very loyal towards his members. Loves and participates in Action movies. Is known for his handsome looks.


Since the members are trained in every aspect, they can therefore easily overtake other positions.
Furthermore, EXO is a vocal heavy group in which each member has a distinct voice, but they are also totally tuned and attuned to one another. That's why it's amazingly dovetail when one member stops singing and the other picks it up.


EXO is arguably one of the most concept heavy groups. They don’t just have MV ‘concepts’ they have their own group ‘mythos’.
According to the mythos, the EXO members are aliens from EXOPLANET. Each member has his own super power. They are chased by an evil force named 'The Red-Force'.
While running from the Red-Force EXO landed on earth. According to theories, the EXO members have lost their memories and live as normal humans on earth, until the mysterious things begin to happen.

EXO's music release dates always overlap with astronomic events.
Until now, every EXO album release date has overlapped with the exact date solar eclipses were seen on Earth!

EXO's motto is 'We Are One'.
EXO and EXO-L also often used the words 'EXO Saranghaja'.
Saranghaja means - Let's Love.
Bepfore EXO goes on stage, all EXO members will hold hands with each other and scream "EXO SARANGAHJA!"

EXO fans are called EXO-L.

The L stands for Love.
It is also the 12th letter in the alphabet and is between K and M (EXO-K, EXO-L, EXO-M). This makes the fandom part of EXO, instead of just a fandom.

A nickname used between the members for their fans is Aeris/Eri. It's derived from EXO-L.
